parkly.description: Parkly is one of Hubilai Tech's (HTI) apps: a parking system on its own PostgreSQL database covering parks, gates and branches, vehicles and access events, cameras, payments/pricing, and a delivery-vehicle parking service (69 tables). Only the tables the parkly team classified Normal are in the lake; the plate and vehicle-movement core (car, carConfig, inOutHistory, inRecord, Payments, worker, branch, ...) is classified Red and not copied, and people/vehicles appear only as UUID tokens.

bronze_ref.parkly_accesstime.description: Pre-silver staging copy of silver.parkly_accesstime with exact (untruncated) timestamps; bronze holds only recent loads and silver is the system of record (claude.md G20), so prefer the silver table. One accessTime record per row, carrying a parkId; parkly domain D1 (Parks, gates & branches). The parkly team classified this table Normal (privacy PDF, 2026-10-02). The meaning of hourType is not documented in any source.

columns.createdAt: Created timestamp (exact source value; truncated to the hour only in silver).
columns.updatedAt: Last-updated timestamp (exact source value; truncated to the hour only in silver).

columns.processedPlates: Integer counter in the source (integer DEFAULT 0), not a person or plate reference. Rows tokenised before the 2026-10 rule fix may still hold UUIDs here until a reload (claude.md G19); stored as string in silver.

silver.parkly_compare.description: One row per discrepancy found when reconciling a car's registration in parkly (carConfig) against the list held on the camera: 'parkly' = car is in carConfig but missing on the camera, 'camera' = on the camera but not in carConfig (source DDL comments). Answers how often camera and parkly lists disagree per park. Loaded in full each run (the source table has no updatedAt). The parkly team classified this table Normal (privacy PDF, 2026-10-02).

columns.device: Where the car is present: 'parkly' = in carConfig but not on the camera; 'camera' = on the camera but not in carConfig (source DDL comment). Rows written before the 2026-10 rule fix may hold UUIDs instead (claude.md G19).
columns.type: Kind of discrepancy: add or remove, or the car's validity has expired but it remains (not deleted) on the camera; the front end shows it as 'not expired' / asks whether to add or remove (source DDL comment).
columns.plateNumber: UUID token of the vehicle plate number - not the real plate.
columns.owner: UUID token of the owner - not a real identity.

silver.parkly_spaychecklog.description: spayCheckLog records (parkly domain D4 Payments & pricing). Caution: the parkly team's privacy PDF classifies spayCheckLog as Red, yet it is loaded; column meanings are not documented in any source.

silver.parkly_workerpark.description: One row per link between a parkly worker and a park (FKs workerId -> worker, parkId -> park). Answers which workers are assigned to which parks. The parkly team classified this table Normal (privacy PDF, 2026-10-02).

columns.workerId: UUID token of the worker - not a real ID.
